title: Trials of Mana - Walls And Steels (Illusion of Gaia style)
description:
A port city theme that's both strong and mysterious, it can fit a wide range of tense situations. Also good for the castle/dungeon of a rich owner.

...And this morning I woke up with the obsession of porting it with the samples of Illusion of Gaia, so I did it.
